Unbearable!! You think we’re jealous of you, you entitled prick? We just want you to leave us alone!

Where did Israelis get this entitlement complex? Our corrupt politicians have given them everything they’ve asked for. And the media is so subservient they just gave Netanyahu huge credit for asking for only ten more years of funding. Credit for robbing us for another ten years!

American media has been Israel's Iron Dome of propaganda. It shielded Israel from legitimate criticism, by firing off antisemite accusations like interceptors to deflect any criticism of Israel. Now, because of social media, their dome isn't holding. The walls have been breached.

Randy Fine said Ilhan Omar should be removed from the country, no Armenian should be allowed to run for office, and that we should kill every man, woman and child in Gaza. Until everyone in power condemns him, I don't want to hear about anyone else getting condemned or canceled.

Why? Why do we need to guarantee that this terrorist state, with weapons of mass destruction, that attacks all of its neighbors have a military advantage in the region? Why do Tom and Nancy in Kansas have to pay to assure that? Or to pay for their genocides? Why do we owe them?

Trump rips us the Iranian peace offer and says peace is on life support. He adds there's only a 1% chance of not going back into the war. Israel says they definitely want to go back in. The markets don't seem to believe them, because they're at record highs. In complete denial.

This is a problem because it's making Trump think the consequences of this war haven't been that bad. In reality, economic consequences are really bad now and cataclysmic if we continue. 

But the markets believe Trump's lies and then he believes their false hope, creating a circle of disinformation which is inflating the bubble even more. This will ironically cause the markets to crash even harder if we restart the war. 

It's amazing to see mass delusion in action.

Everyone acknowledges we would have never gone to war with Iran if Israel didn't push us into it. It's obvious no other country could have made us start a needless war on their behalf. So, the only question left is their degree of control. If we re-start the war, then it's 100%.

Netanyahu is right. It was social media that hurt Israel's standing in the world. But all it did was put up videos of what the Israelis had done. They're telling on themselves. They had mainstream media locked up. They're so mad that the truth got out of their net of propaganda.

The media is reporting that Netanyahu said Israel shouldn't take any more money from America. That's to give him credit so he looks good to Americans who are sick of paying his bills. Reality is he said we should continue it for ONLY ANOTHER TEN YEARS. No, let's end it RIGHT NOW!

The fact that American media helps him execute this trick, instead of pointing it out, tells you all you need to know about the national media. And they act like it's normal that we continue to pay the bills of a foreign government for another ten years. Why is that normal?
